items.title: 9.7.3 Importance of Collaboration and Iteration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.7.3 (PDF 221-222), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Collaboration aur iteration is liye aham hain ke in se behtar results milte hain aur doosron se seekhne ka mauqa milta hai. Mil kar kaam karne se aap sab ka ilm aur skills jama kar ke mushkil (complex) masail hal kar sakte hain. Iteration se aap apna kaam har qadam par refine karte (nikharte) aur behtar banate hain.

Misal: Pakistan ke bohat se shehron aur qasbon mein mohalle ke log aksar clean-up drive (safai muhim) ke liye ikatthe hote hain. Shuru mein woh tay karte hain ke kahan se shuru karna hai aur kin jagahon par sab se zyada tawajjo chahiye. Kaam karte hue unhein pata chalta hai ke kuch kaam umeed se zyada waqt le rahe hain ya zyada volunteers (bina tankhwah madad karne wale) chahiye. Woh apna plan badalte hain (iterate) aur mil kar kaam jari rakhte hain (collaborate) jab tak poora ilaqa saaf na ho jaye.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Mashhoor Indus Valley Civilization (Wadi-e-Sindh ki tehzeeb), jo aaj ke Pakistan ke ilaqe mein thi, apni town planning (shehar ka naqsha banana) aur construction (tameer) ke tareeqon mein collaboration aur iteration ki shuru ki misalein dikhati hai!

blocks.prompt: Collaboration aur iteration naye karobar ki kamyabi mein kaise hissa dalte hain? Misalein dijiye (long question 8).
blocks.explanation: Collaboration mukhtalif skills wale partners ko jorta hai, jaise ek baker aur ek business manager mil kar business plan likhte hain; kaam bat jata hai aur ideas behtar hote hain. Iteration mein pehle saada version shuru kar ke customers ki raye li jati hai aur baar baar behtari ki jati hai, jaise juice ki dukaan pehle mahine ki sales dekh kar menu badalti hai; is se product market ki zaroorat ke mutabiq ho jata hai aur ghaltiyan chhoti reh jati hain. Dono mil kar risk kam karte hain aur karobar ko badalte halaat ke saath chalate hain.

items: Collaboration ilm aur skills jama karta hai; iteration kaam ko har qadam par behtar karta hai (safai muhim).
